task_name: Kolmogorov-Arnold Graph Neural Networks for Molecular Property Prediction
primary_objective: Design and evaluate KA-GNNs that replace MLP-based transformations with Fourier-based KAN modules for enhanced predictive accuracy, efficiency, and interpretability

architecture.name: KA-GNN (Kolmogorov-Arnold Graph Neural Network)
architecture.core_innovation: Replace conventional MLP transformations in GNN layers with Fourier-based Kolmogorov-Arnold Network modules
architecture.theoretical_basis: Kolmogorov-Arnold representation theorem provides stronger expressive power and approximation guarantees
architecture.input_representation: Molecular graphs with atom-level features as nodes and bond-level features (covalent and non-covalent) as edges
architecture.output: Binary classification predictions for molecular properties

baselines.name: GCN
baselines.description: Graph Convolutional Network with MLP transformations

baselines.name: GAT
baselines.description: Graph Attention Network with MLP transformations

baselines.name: GraphSAGE
baselines.description: Graph Sample and Aggregate with MLP transformations

interpretability_approach.rationale: Fourier basis functions in KAN provide inherent interpretability through learned frequency components

target_outputs.quantitative_results: ROC-AUC scores for each dataset and model
target_outputs.comparison_tables: Model performance comparison across all datasets
